evidence.observation: O2 at growth onset low (~3.7 ppm) after successful purge
O2 rises monotonically 3.7→26 ppm over the growth stage, consistent with air ingress
Temperature holds 750 °C, heater power and Ar flow steady and nominal
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak cannot be confirmed

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or a static leak-up/flow-stop test to distinguish a seal leak from an O2 sensor drift or outgassing source
